events.headline: Cyberpunk 2027 — new single from That Boy Hi Hat drops October 20, 2026
events.body: That Boy Hi Hat's new single 'Cyberpunk 2027' releases October 20, 2026. Pre-save is live on Apple Music. The track is the lead single exemplifying Post-Trap Futurism — the genre That Boy Hi Hat originated.
